chunks: And Zurarah narrated from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام that he said:

The rows should be complete and continuous, one of them joined to another, and there should not be between the two rows a gap that cannot be crossed; rather, that should be the measure of the space occupied by a human body when he performs sajdah.

key_terms.الصَّفَّيْنِ: the two adjacent rows in prayer
key_terms.الصُّفُوفِ: the prayer rows in congregational salat
key_terms.مَسْقَطَ: the extent or space occupied by something falling or being placed down
key_terms.مُتَوَاصِلَةً: connected and continuous with one another

ai.seo_question: How should the rows be arranged in congregational prayer according to Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs that the rows in congregational salat should be complete and closely connected. It indicates that excessive gaps between rows are contrary to proper arrangement, and that only a minimal space corresponding to the place needed for sajdah is appropriate.
